content_sections.heading: About AIC-AUDF
content_sections.text: AIC-AUDF is a Section 8 (Not-for-Profit) Company of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi. According to the notice, it was established to promote innovation, entrepreneurship and incubation activities. The CEO reports to the Board of Directors / Chairman, Board of Directors, through a nominated Director.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: Postgraduate degree or higher in Management, Science, Engineering, or any other relevant field. Essential experience: Minimum 8 years of professional experience at managerial level, including at least 2 years in the start-up incubation ecosystem. More than 5 years of experience in entrepreneurial research, innovation ecosystem, startup ecosystem, venture capital and industry collaboration. Preference will be given to candidates having experience in a govt. organization. The maximum age limit is preferably below 50 years (relaxable for the right candidate). The notice prints no date for counting age and no minimum age. For the full eligibility conditions, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The compensation range is Rs. 12,00,000 to Rs. 30,00,000 per annum. The notice also lists performance-linked variable pay, subject to achievement of defined KPIs, and additional managerial benefits as per organisational norms. The tenure is initially one year on a contractual basis, extendable by mutual consent, subject to satisfactory performance and the requirements of AIC-AUDF. The appointment is purely contractual and does not confer any right to permanent employment or absorption in the University or AIC-AUDF. The role involves domestic and international travel, as required for organisational activities.

content_sections.heading: AIC-AUDF Chief Executive Officer Job Description
content_sections.text: Develop long-term strategic roadmaps aligned with national and state innovation priorities. Build, lead, and inspire a high-performance multidisciplinary team. Establish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and data-driven monitoring frameworks, including Management Information System (MIS) dashboards. Scale pre-incubation, incubation, and acceleration programmes. Facilitate market access, mentorship, and funding opportunities for startups through government schemes, angel networks, and venture capital firms. Drive the financial sustainability of AIC-AUDF through diversified revenue streams, including CSR funding, government grants, consultancy, and equity participation. Ensure financial discipline, effective resource utilisation, and transparent budgeting. Maintain active collaborations with the Host University, government ministries, corporates, and international organisations. Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, taxation laws, and applicable financial and regulatory requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIC-AUDF Chief Executive Officer
content_sections.text: Eligible and interested candidates must submit their detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) by email to [email protected] on or before 24 November 2026. The notice prints no time for the deadline, no email subject line and no application form. Documents named in the notice: Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The mode of selection is Direct Selection, made up of shortlisting, presentation and Board interview. The notice does not describe how each stage is scored or when the interview will be held.
